messages:
Harper: noticed weirdness with stacked-area panels: when more than 6 series are stacked the legend compresses and the focus order jumps around for screen readers. repro: /dash/serving, narrow width. screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/stack-legend-jump.png
Maya: saw that. stack mode changes visual dominance; legend ordering (top->bottom) is currently visual-first which breaks SR linearity. we should decouple SR order from visual order.
Liam: proposal: keep visual stacking as-is but expose a stable reading order attribute for accessibility: aria-pos="n" on each legend item so SR reads from primary metric -> others. default: pinned or top-importance first.
Ollie: also, unit grouping matters. stacked charts often mix % and absolute counts which is confusing. suggestion: split legend into grouped sections (Units: % | Count) with headers that are keyboard-focusable.
Harper: microcopy for group header: "Group: Percent metrics" and "Group: Absolute metrics". group headers announce count (e.g., "Percent metrics, 3 items").
Maya: keyboard flow: Tab to legend, Up/Down arrows navigate items, H toggles group collapse, Space toggles series visibility. when a group collapses announce: "Group collapsed, 2 hidden" via aria-live.
Liam: implementation note: provide a stable id in payload (seriesKey) and a priorityHint so client can decide SR order without reordering visuals. payload can include "priorityHint":"1" as string to match existing conventions.
Ollie: UX nit: smoothing toggle currently recalculates stacking percentages and jumps values. propose a transient badge in the legend header: "Ranking uses current smoothing" with tooltip explaining that smoothed stacking shares differ from raw.
Harper: spike handling: for stacked areas spikes create tiny jagged bumps. offer an "area smoothing" mode that smooths the curve but keeps raw markers accessible via a legend toggle. microcopy: "Smooth area shapes; raw spikes still accessible via marker overlay".
Maya: SR checklist: 1) stable reading order separate from visual stack 2) group headers with counts 3) aria-controls on collapse 4) live region announcements for ranking & collapse 5) keyboard shortcuts documented.
Liam: action items: Ollie -> prototype grouped legend + SR order attrs; Maya -> draft a11y spec and keyboard mapping; Harper -> copy for tooltips and badges. sync Tuesday 11am.
